purpose: A new customer who has shared a complete profile, spending, savings and goals, and has answered the first part of the questionnaire, but has no investment trading history and has not answered the risk-tolerance questions. The risk model has nothing to classify, so the existing pipeline stops at its low-confidence branch and asks for more information; compliance, portfolio, recommendation and explanation are never produced. The pending state is the real outcome of that missing input.
also_created_by: frontend/src/lib/demo-customer.ts (the resolveDemoCustomer fallback), with these same profile and goal values
risk_data_link_unavailable_reason: Deliberately unlinked: this customer has no investment trading history, so the risk model has no input and the analysis asks for more information. Unknown is not guessed.
